About Privacy Scores
Privacy scores assess the data classification and exposure profile of each supplier. Key drivers: Customer Data (Q11), Personal Data (Q13), and Sensitive Data (Q14) in scope. Scores < 1 indicate no meaningful data exposure; scores ≥ 4 indicate Moderate or higher privacy risk requiring closer review. Thresholds: Very High ≥ 9 · High ≥ 7 · Moderate ≥ 4 · Low ≥ 2 · Very Low < 2.
🔒 Privacy Due Diligence Tracker — All Suppliers
Supplier ↕ Privacy Score ↕ Data Classification Customer Data Personal Data Sensitive Data Subprocessor DD Status ↕
* Privacy score is domain-weighted at 20% of total IRR. Score reflects data classification and personal/sensitive data exposure. Score = 0 indicates no data in scope.

About TPS / Security Scores
TPS (Third Party Security) scores are provided by Aaron Fig's team and reflect the supplier's security posture based on Q1–Q12 responses. Q1=No means TPS is not applicable — the supplier does not handle classified Salesforce data or technology. For those with TPS required, score 10 = Very High security risk, 7 = High. Thresholds: Very High ≥ 9 · High ≥ 7 · Moderate ≥ 4 · Low ≥ 2 · Very Low < 2.

About Financial Scores
Financial scores assess concentration risk and spend exposure. Key drivers: spend over $1M (Q21), availability of alternate suppliers (Q20), supplier revenue dependence (Q22), and prepayment exposure (Q24). Higher scores indicate greater financial concentration risk. Thresholds: Very High ≥ 9 · High ≥ 7 · Moderate ≥ 4 · Low ≥ 2 · Very Low < 2.

* Financial score is domain-weighted at 20% of total IRR. Key drivers: spend >$1M (Q21), no alternates (Q20), revenue dependence (Q22), prepayment (Q24). Score 5 is default for unknown revenue impact.
